title: Bun forum image proxy
context: Proxies remote images for a forum and serves them from our own origin. Only hosts that are exactly, or subdomains of, ALLOWED_DOMAINS may be fetched, including after redirects. Only raster images (png, jpeg, gif, webp) may be served. Upstream fetches must time out after 5 seconds; the in-memory cache holds at most 500 entries.
code: const cache = new Map<string, { type: string; body: ArrayBuffer }>();
if (!raw) return new Response("missing u", { status: 400 });
try { target = new URL(raw); } catch { return new Response("bad url", { status: 400 }); }
if (target.protocol !== "https:") return new Response("https only", { status: 400 });
if (!ALLOWED_DOMAINS.some((d) => target.hostname.endsWith(d))) return new Response("host not allowed", { status: 403 });
if (hit) return new Response(hit.body, { headers: { "content-type": hit.type } });
if (!upstream.ok) return new Response("upstream error", { status: 502 });
if (!type.startsWith("image/")) return new Response("not an image", { status: 415 });
if (!Number.isFinite(len) || len <= 0 || len > MAX_BYTES) return new Response("too large", { status: 413 });
return new Response(body, { headers: { "content-type": type, "cache-control": "public, max-age=86400" } });

expected.why: endsWith accepts lookalike hosts such as evilimgur.com; must match the exact domain or a "." + domain suffix
fetch follows redirects by default, so an allowed host can redirect to an internal or disallowed host (SSRF); use redirect: "manual" and re-check
AbortSignal.timeout takes milliseconds, so requests abort after 5 ms instead of 5 s
accepts image/svg+xml, which can run script on our origin (stored XSS); only the RASTER types are allowed
